scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:frontend: cross-env BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:4000 npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:frontend: cross-env BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:4000 npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run start:prod" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
